row.notes: Large-payload logger for F1OS method 'GetInbox', called 3x from Game_F1os_OnResult_GetInbox with the reply body {ptr,?,size}: body NULL -> logs 'HTTPRequest: No Payload received for %s:%s' (service +0x110, method +0x118) on F1OS; size > 0xFFFFF (1 MiB) -> copies the first 2047 bytes to a stack buffer and logs 'HTTPRequest: Payload for %s:%s (%u bytes) %s' on F1OS-LARGEPAYLOAD; smaller bodies are not logged. Addon: enable F1OS-LARGEPAYLOAD or hook to dump big GetInbox replies. | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner re-career-teams (independent agree V3350)
